create_torch_version: create a TorchVersion object to compare PyTorch versions against Version objects, tuples, and strings
test_torchversion_gt: test TorchVersion greater-than comparison against a Version object like '1.10.0a' > Version('1.10.0a')
test_torchversion_tuple: test TorchVersion comparison against version tuples like (1, 2, 1) for semantic version checking
test_torchversion_string: test TorchVersion string comparison against version strings like '1.2.1' for backward compatibility
refactor_torchversion_fallback: refactor TorchVersion to fall back to string comparison when version parsing fails on invalid inputs
